programs.title: Kangaroo Beach
programs.desc: Frizzy and Gemma investigate the mysterious disappearance of several boats in Kangaroo Beach's 'Barramundi Triangle'.

programs.title: The Octonauts
programs.sub_title: The Octonauts and the Giant Squid
programs.desc: The Octonauts set out to find and photograph Inkling's long lost cousin, the elusive Giant Squid.

programs.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programs.desc: When Thomas helps Nia make a delivery to the beach in Norramby, he insists he knows a shortcut and leads the way! But it turns out his memory isn't as good as he. remembered.

programs.title: Play School: World By Night
programs.desc: Alex and Rachael make a glow worm diorama using awesome glow-in-the-dark paint! They're joined by special guest Ravi and his Barn Owl, Diva! The toys go camping in the bush and see animals that come out at night.

programs.title: Fireman Sam
programs.desc: When the banks of the Pontypandy River burst, Mandy and Norman go on an adventure to rescue their wildlife journal and… sandwiches?

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: While playing pretend pirate ship in the playground with her friends, Miffy goes a bit 'overboard' and is unwilling to let her playmates take a turn at being the captain.

programs.title: The Woohoos!
programs.desc: The Woohoos see the moon apparently disappearing and think something is eating it! They work out that sometimes a big shadow moves over the moon so it looks like it disappears then reappears.

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Dream Detectives
programs.desc: When Nikhil wakes up, he misses the end of his amazing dream! Jay tries lots of ways to help him find the ending so they can tell it at their 'share a story' picnic.

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: Daniel is so excited for the Spring Sing at school today, but when he arrives, he discovers that Teacher Harriet is not there to teach the routine to the students. The class meets a substitute teacher named Mr. Malik.

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: Mayor Sourdough is going to build a cat playground for the kittens, but he realizes he doesn't know what kittens like. He gets Mittens to show him what being a cat is all about.

programs.title: BeddyByes
programs.desc: MeMo and BaBa play dress up. BaBa is sad when a pretty tutu doesn't fit, but fits MeMo perfectly. MeMo sees that BaBa is sad and finds a way for them to both play with the tutu.

programs.title: Mixmups
programs.desc: The Mixmups go on an adventure to experience being cool like pockets. Will Pockets be able to show them how she can see differently?
